report_es:
Veredicto, escrito por el código: ninguno. No se pudieron orientar dos cámaras, así que no hay trayectoria ni velocidad que juzgar.

Informe: destello sobre Colombia del 30 de julio de 2025 a las 22:50 (UTC-5, hora de Colombia), correspondiente al 31 de julio de 2025 a las 03:50:24Z.

Lo sólido: un satélite registró un bólido en 6.460 grados norte (N), 72.212 grados oeste (W), con confianza media y duración de 1.047533 segundos, no aislado de rayos cercanos. Existe video de Medellín (cancha de baloncesto), a 373 kilómetros del destello, pero se desconoce el punto exacto de grabación. De Bucaramanga, a 124 kilómetros, solo hubo una publicación de texto: nunca llevó video adjunto; la cuenta fue suspendida después.

Lo incierto: ninguna cámara pudo orientarse por falta de puntos de referencia confirmados, por lo que la solución no usa ninguna cámara y ninguna quedó apartada, y la geometría es insuficiente para trayectoria y velocidad.

Falta: vistas cercanas desde Málaga (63 kilómetros), Saravena (66 kilómetros) y alrededores. En reentradas, ningún objeto contiene el destello; lo más próximo es OBJECT C, a 2.1 horas del borde de su ventana prevista.
report_en:
Verdict, written by the code: none. Fewer than two cameras could be oriented, so there is no trajectory and no speed to judge.

On 2025-07-30 22:50 (UTC-5, Colombia time), 2025-07-31T03:50:24Z, a flash was recorded over Colombia.

What is solid: a space-based lightning sensor recorded a Bolide at 6.460 N, 72.212 W with medium confidence, lasting 1.047533 seconds. Lightning was nearby, so the flash was not isolated.

Witness material: video exists only from Medellín (basketball court), about 373 km from the flash; its filming spot is unknown and no camera could be oriented from surveyed landmarks. The Bucaramanga item was a text-only post about 124 km away; no video was ever attached to it, and the account was suspended later.

As a result, no cameras could be oriented, the solution uses none, and none were set aside. Geometry is insufficient for a trajectory.

Uncertain and missing: no known re-entry window contains the flash. The nearest tracked object, OBJECT C, has a 2 hour predicted window whose edge is 2.1 hours from the flash, followed by STARLINK-2038 at 8.1 hours; a predicted window is not a ground track. Views from Málaga (63 km), Saravena (66 km) and nearby towns are still needed.

request.why: No oriented cameras exist so videos from towns that would see flash high up are needed.

run.notes: From a claims check by the AI coding assistant, not a person's review: there was never a video from Bucaramanga, because the post was text only, so do not say a video was lost or that the account's suspension removed it. The 2.1 hours is the gap between the edge of OBJECT C's predicted window and the flash, not the time until its predicted re-entry.
